name: trust
description: TLS server authentication by the operating system's trust, as Go's crypto/x509 does it: macOS's SecTrustEvaluateWithError and Windows's CertGetCertificateChain with the SSL policy, on a thread a poll loop waits on, and on Linux x509::verify against the system's anchors (its bundle and certificate directories, or SSL_CERT_FILE and SSL_CERT_DIR, read on raw system calls). system() also loads the anchors themselves on all three: macOS's trust domains with their SSL trust settings, Windows's ROOT store less what is disabled for server authentication or Disallowed.
